title: First Opening of Heavenly Eye
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji traced the source of that gaze following the guidance of the Turtle Shell's runes, an unexpected name surfaced—it pointed to the founding patriarch of the Tianqing Sect, who had retired from the world many years ago.

text.content:
Midnight, third quarter of the Zi hour.

At the edge of the Cold Pool in the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain Forbidden Grounds, Chen Ji sat cross-legged, spiritual lights swirling around him like fine threads. The aftershocks of the Sect Tournament had not yet settled, and the noise from the Servants' Quarters was already far behind. Only the mountain wind howled through the jagged rocks.

He should have taken advantage of the quiet night to sort out his recent gains and losses, yet something felt off during today's cultivation—as if an invisible needle was gently pricking the back of his head, faint and elusive, yet impossible to shake off.

(Chapter One, no preceding hook—the story begins here)

Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly as he slowly opened his eyes.

All around was deathly silence, the Cold Pool's surface like a mirror reflecting the star-filled sky. However, the moment he raised his head, that feeling of being watched suddenly intensified tenfold—as if some unimaginable existence was gazing down at him from extremely high and far away.

Not an illusion.

This feeling was familiar, like the trembling of being watched by fate itself when he first activated the Tianji Record. Yet today's gaze was more terrifying, for it carried no emotion whatsoever—only pure, indiscriminate observation.

Chen Ji's back was instantly soaked with cold sweat.

The existence that could watch him was by no means a mortal cultivator.

What on earth was it?

dialogue.content:
【Be careful.】

An old, hoarse voice resounded directly in Chen Ji's mind, like dry leaves rubbing together. Mo Xiansheng—the residual soul guardian dwelling on the first page of the Tianji Record—spoke with rare gravity in his tone.

【It has come. Faster than I anticipated.】

text.content:
Before the words even finished, the Jade Pendant on Chen Ji's chest suddenly burned like fire.

That was where the Tianji Record Fragment was stored, and now it trembled violently, as if emitting some kind of warning hum. Chen Ji quickly clutched the Jade Pendant in his palm, feeling that familiar yet alien power surging frantically.

The runes on the Fragment flickered uncertainly, and a line of blurry text appeared:

『Heavenly Eye has opened, do not act rashly.』

Six characters, yet they made Chen Ji's pupils contract sharply.

Heavenly Eye—was this the source of that gaze?

Chen Ji rose abruptly, his gaze piercing through the night sky.

At that moment, he saw it.

Above the nine heavens, behind the layers of clouds, an eye faintly visible slowly opened. Its pupil was composed of countless stars, its sclera the churning chaos qi, and within the depths of its pupil seemed to lie an emptiness capable of devouring everything.

It had no eyelids, no eye socket—only that icy eyeball suspended between heaven and earth, indifferently gazing upon the living beings below.

And that eye was staring fixedly at him.

Chen Ji felt as if all the blood in his body was about to freeze.

This was no illusion. This was—Heavenly Dao.

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down.

He mentally recited: Mo Xiansheng, what exactly is this? Why did it appear suddenly?

His voice was pressed extremely low, almost communicating through divine sense. He knew such an existence might perceive all speech, but divine sense communication could at least buy him a moment's reaction time.

The residual soul guardian fell silent for a moment before speaking slowly:

【This is the Eye of Heavenly Dao.】

【It is not the first time it has watched you.】

【Those who possess the Tianji Record have been watched by it since ancient times.】

Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a trace of bitterness:

【Do you think the Tianji Record is what? It is neither a cultivation technique nor a secret art—it is a piece placed by Heavenly Dao on the board of the mortal world. Every generation of prophets served as its eyes, observing the living for it.】

【And now, it has discovered a variable appearing on the chessboard.】

【A piece that should have followed procedure has begun to break free from its control.】

text.content:
Chen Ji felt a chill crawl from the soles of his feet to the crown of his head.

So this was the true nature of the Tianji Record?

He had thought himself the chess player, the mastermind secretly arranging the world. But only now did he realize he might have been manipulated from the very start.

That giant eye still hung in the heavens, showing no further action, yet给予 Chen Ji a pressing feeling like a mountain bearing down.

Not unable to move, but afraid to move.

As if the moment he made any slight movement, he would be utterly obliterated by the eye's master.

Was this the majesty of Heavenly Dao?

choice.prompt: Faced with the gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Dao, Chen Ji needed to make a choice. The pressure brought by that gaze was like substantial matter, but his consistent approach was never to sit still—yet this time, he faced an existence beyond mortal comprehension.

choices.description: Chen Ji slowly raised his head, directly facing that giant eye. Since retreat was impossible, he might as well face it calmly—he had never feared any existence, even if it was Heavenly Dao.
choices.visible_reward: Under pressure,，激发 unprecedented willpower, causing brief resonance with the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: May provoke the Eye of Heavenly Dao, facing unpredictable backlash

text.content:
Chen Ji slowly raised his head, directly facing that giant eye.

He did not dodge, did not retreat, but met that gaze with an almost insane posture.

The Tianji Record trembled violently in his palm, as if sensing its master's will. The runes on the Fragment flickered frantically, bursting forth a blinding golden light, confronting that icy giant eye from afar.

In that moment, Chen Ji felt something open in his mind—he vaguely saw the deeper Void beyond that eye, and the countless tangled threads of cause and effect within the Void.

And among those threads, one was connected to himself.

choices.description: Chen Ji suppressed the fighting intent in his heart, proactively收敛 the Tianji Record's aura. Since the opponent was overwhelmingly powerful, temporary forbearance was the wise choice—he never fought battles without certainty of victory.
choices.visible_reward: Successfully concealed whereabouts, buying time for subsequent investigation
choices.risk_hint: May have one's aura locked by the Eye of Heavenly Dao, never able to escape

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, slowly closing his eyes.

He began to收敛 his aura using the secret technique taught by Mo Xiansheng. The Tianji Record's fluctuations gradually settled, turning into an ordinary Jade Pendant dormant on his chest.

That giant eye's gaze still existed, yet it seemed to have lost focus. It slowly turned in the sky, as if searching for something, yet could never lock onto the aura that had just confronted it.

A moment later, that eye slowly closed, disappearing behind the clouds.

But Chen Ji knew it had not truly left—only waiting for the next time it would gaze upon him.

Regardless of the choice, after the Eye of Heavenly Dao dissipated, Chen Ji remained unable to calm himself for a long time.

He stood by the Cold Pool, allowing the night wind to blow upon his robes, countless thoughts churning in his heart.

Mo Xiansheng said every generation of prophets was a piece of Heavenly Dao—then had his fate, from the moment he obtained the Tianji Record, already been arranged?

What did his schemes to arrange the world amount to in this greater game?

Chen Ji closed his eyes, yet a cold smile curled at the corner of his mouth.

Even if he was a piece, he would be the one capable of overturning the chessboard.

He never believed in so-called destiny—if the Tianji Record could foresee the future, then the future was not set in stone.

As long as there were variables, there was opportunity to break the局.

dialogue.content:
【What do you intend to do?】

Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded again, carrying a hint of scrutiny.

【It has already noticed you. From now on, every time you use the Tianji Record, perhaps it will be under its watchful eye.】

Chen Ji opened his eyes, a cold light flickering in his gaze:

Then let it watch.

【...】

【You're not afraid?】

Afraid?

Chen Ji let out a cold laugh:

Would fear help? Since it wants to treat me as a piece, then let it see what waves a mad piece can create.

text.content:
"Just as Chen Ji was about to leave, the Tianji Record Fragment warmed again.

He lowered his gaze to see a string of tiny runes appearing on the back of the fragment, slowly moving along some profound trajectory. That was not the original content of the Tianji Record, but—

A new revelation.

Chen Ji gazed at those runes, his pupils contracting sharply.

The direction the symbols pointed to was the Scripture Repository deep within the sect—that was the forbidden grounds of Tianqing Sect, where ordinary disciples were forbidden to enter. And there, it seemed, was hidden some clue related to the Heavenly Eye.

Mo Xiansheng also fell silent, seemingly contemplating what this meant."

choice.prompt: "The Tianji Record Fragment points to the Scripture Repository, where clues about the Heavenly Eye may be hidden. But the Scripture Repository is forbidden ground of the Tianqing Sect—rushing in recklessly would have dire consequences. Should I take the risk or plan carefully?"

choices.description: "Opportunity waits for no one. The Heavenly Eye has just departed—the guards must be lax. If not now, then when?"
choices.visible_reward: "May obtain key intelligence about the Heavenly Eye"
choices.risk_hint: "If discovered, having one's cultivation abolished would be the light punishment"

text.content:
"Chen Ji didn't hesitate in the slightest. His figure vanished into the night.

He moved along the familiar route across the rooftops of Tianqing Sect, his steps light as falling leaves. His servant identity became the best cover at this moment—no one would pay attention to atrash disciple walking late at night.

However, just as he was about to approach the Scripture Repository, his steps suddenly halted.

On the third floor of the pavilion, behind a window, faint candlelight was burning.

Someone was there.

And that candlelight's aura... seemed familiar."

choices.description: "Entering the forbidden ground late at night is too risky. Better to find a legitimate reason tomorrow and take the opportunity to scout the situation."
choices.visible_reward: "Won't expose my whereabouts; can lay out plans at leisure"
choices.risk_hint: "If the other party becomes aware, we may miss the first opportunity"

text.content:
"Chen Ji suppressed the impulse in his heart and quietly withdrew.

He returned to the small hut in the Servants' Quarters, lit an oil lamp, and sorted through everything that happened that night under the dim lamplight.

The Tianji Record pointed to the Scripture Repository, proving there truly were clues related to the Heavenly Eye there. But rushing in recklessly was too dangerous—if discovered, not only would the plan fall through, but it might also alert the enemy.

He needed a reasonable excuse.

Tomorrow was the Inner Disciple Monthly Scripture Repository Opening Day. He could use Su Qingyao's name to gain entry...

A slight smile curved his lips as Chen Ji began calculating secretly."

choices.description: "Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist can conceal aura. Why not let her investigate while I command from behind?"
choices.visible_reward: "With Ye Qing acting, success rate greatly increases, and I won't be exposed"
choices.risk_hint: "The trustworthiness of Demonic Path cultivators is questionable—complications may arise"

text.content:
"Chen Ji took out from his怀 a jade talisman as black as ink and gently crushed it.

That was the communication secret talisman for contacting Ye Qing. Once shattered, it would form a demonic energy fluctuation only she could perceive.

Soon, a cold divine sense transmission came:

【What's the matter?】

Chen Ji briefly explained the night's events and made his request.

A moment later, Ye Qing's reply carried a hint of amusement:

【The Heavenly Eye? Interesting. Fine, but you owe me one.】

Chen Ji's lips twitched, but he could only nod in agreement.

Compared to a debt of favor, his命 was more important."

"After handling the matter at hand, Chen Ji redirected his attention to the string of emerging runes.

He carefully examined those wandering traces and discovered they seemed to be guiding toward a direction—not the Scripture Repository itself, but a specific location within it.

Third floor, southeast corner, seventh row of bookshelves.

What was stored there?

Chen Ji fell into contemplation. From his understanding, the third floor of the Scripture Repository stored the cultivation notes of successive sect leaders through the ages, as well as some ancient scroll fragments of unknown origin. If something related to the Heavenly Eye existed, it truly might be hidden there.

But what intrigued him even more was another matter—

The arrangement of those runes was identical to the patterns on a certain artifact he had seen before.

That was... the Turtle Shell.

The runes on the Turtle Shell fragment he had obtained at some ruins years ago were precisely of this style."

"Chen Ji took out that treasured Turtle Shell from his storage bag.

The Turtle Shell was entirely pitch-black, its surface carved with dense ancient runes. Despite the erosion of time, it still emitted a faint ethereal glow. This was a treasure he had incidentally obtained years ago, whose purpose he had never been able to decipher—now it resonated with the Tianji Record.

The runes began to glow.

The Turtle Shell and the runes on the Tianji Record Fragment responded to each other across the distance, forming a complete information loop. Chen Ji's pupils sharply contracted—

So that was it.

The Turtle Shell was a辅助 artifact of the Tianji Record. Only when combined could they unleash true power. And now, together they pointed to one conclusion:

The Heavenly Eye was not invincible.

In ancient times, someone had successfully evaded its gaze, and even... deceived it."

"This discovery made Chen Ji's heartbeat suddenly accelerate.

Since predecessors could do it, so could he.

Moreover—if he could hide his whereabouts under the Heavenly Eye's gaze, that meant he could continue using the Tianji Record's abilities undetected. This was crucial for his upcoming arrangements.

But the problem was, although the Turtle Shell recorded methods to evade the Heavenly Eye's gaze, the most critical link was missing—that part of the information seemed to have been deliberately erased.

【Someone is deliberately concealing something.】

Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded softly, carrying a hint of深意.

【Or rather, someone is waiting for you to discover that truth yourself.】

Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly.

Another puzzle.

But no matter—he enjoyed solving puzzles most—then turning the tables on those who set them."

dialogue.content:
"【Boy, what do you plan to do now?】

Mo Xiansheng's voice carried an undertone of examination.

Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then slowly spoke:

First, find that erased information.

【The Scripture Repository?】

Not only there.

Chen Ji's gaze fell on the runes of the Turtle Shell, his eyes flickering:

Both the Turtle Shell and the Tianji Record point to the same place, indicating key clues are hidden there. But what I want to know more is—

Who erased the information on the Turtle Shell?

And for what purpose?

【...You want to investigate the person behind this?】

Chen Ji coldly smiled:

No. I only want to know who had the qualification to know these secrets before me.

Then, make him my chess piece."

choice.prompt: "The resonance between the Tianji Record and the Turtle Shell gave Chen Ji an important clue—the Scripture Repository may hold key information on how to evade the Heavenly Eye's gaze. But at the same time, this also raised a greater mystery: Who set this chess game on the Turtle Shell?"

choices.text: Investigating the Origin of the Turtle Shell
choices.description: Following the clues to trace the original source of the turtle shell. Those who can access secrets of this level are far from ordinary.
choices.visible_cost: Requires consumption of time and resources
choices.visible_reward: May discover the true identity of the mastermind
choices.risk_hint: Since the other party dared to set up this scheme, they likely prepared defenses long ago

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes and began searching his memory for the turtle shell's origin. It was five years ago. Back then, he was merely a newly entered servant disciple, chopping wood at the Rear Mountain when he stumbled upon a collapsed ancient cave. The turtle shell had come from within. At the time, he paid it no mind, dismissing it as an ordinary antique. But now, recalling it, that ancient cave's layout was remarkably sophisticated—far beyond what ordinary cultivators could create. The inscription carved at the cave's entrance seemed to read... 'Tianqing's First Generation, Place of Transcendence.' Chen Ji's eyes snapped open abruptly, his pupils contracting sharply. The First Generation Ancestor?

choices.text: Proceed Immediately to the Scripture Repository
choices.description: Regardless of who the mastermind is, securing the clues from the Scripture Repository first is the priority. Intelligence in hand means controlling the initiative.
choices.visible_cost: May trigger formations or alert the guards
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial information to evade Heaven's Watch
choices.risk_hint: If the other party set a trap in the Scripture Repository, there may be no return

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no longer. His figure blurred as he darted toward the Scripture Repository. The night wind howled, his silhouette ghosting across rooftops. Using his intimate knowledge of the sect's terrain, he chose the most concealed route—the path known only to servant disciples. In a moment, the outline of the Scripture Repository appeared. The three-story tower cast a massive shadow under the moonlight, like a slumbering beast. Chen Ji approached quietly, only to discover—Countless formations invisible to the naked eye surrounded the tower. If he forcibly entered, he would trigger the alarm. But so what? A cold smile curved his lips as Chen Ji drew a token from his怀— the merit token from the competition reward, granting passage through most areas of the sect. Formations are fixed, but people are flexible.

choices.description: Master Mo has extensive knowledge; perhaps he knows the turtle shell's origin and the Scripture Repository's secrets. Better to ask clearly before taking action.
choices.visible_cost: Requires consumption of Tianji Record information permissions
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial intelligence and avoid pitfalls
choices.risk_hint: Master Mo may not reveal everything

text.content: Chen Ji stopped in his tracks and asked in his heart: Sir, you are widely knowledgeable—do you know the origin of this turtle shell? After a moment of silence, Master Mo's voice sounded slowly: This thing... seems somewhat familiar. If I recall correctly, it should be related to the First Generation Ancestor. That ancestor, before ascending, left behind a batch of legacy items hidden in the sect's Forbidden Grounds. The turtle shell in your hand is probably one of them. The First Generation Ancestor... Chen Ji frowned slightly: What relationship does that ancestor have with the Eye of Heavenly Way? ...That question, you are not yet qualified to know. Master Mo's tone suddenly turned cold: Wait until you truly touch that realm before asking.

As Chen Ji pondered, a low rumble echoed from the horizon in the direction where the Eye of Heavenly Way had vanished. He looked up to see a purple-black crack slowly tearing open in that direction. Tendrils of demonic energy seeped from the fissure, completely out of place with the righteous sect's aura. A demonic path invasion? No. Chen Ji narrowed his eyes—he knew that demonic fluctuation too well. It was Ye Qing's aura. Why would she be in that direction? Could the Scripture Repository's secrets be related to the demonic path? A pall of gloom settled over Chen Ji's heart. The Eye of Heavenly Way, the turtle shell, the First Generation Ancestor, the demonic path saint... these seemingly unrelated clues were gradually weaving into a massive net. And he, it seemed, was being drawn toward the net's center.

The night wind grew cool, and a faint whiteness began to tinge the eastern horizon. Chen Ji had stood at the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain for an entire night, yet felt not a trace of fatigue. Too much information needed digestion, too many mysteries awaited solving. The Eye of Heavenly Way's gaze meant all his actions were under surveillance. The turtle shell's connection to the Tianji Record pointed to secrets left by the First Generation Ancestor. And Ye Qing's sudden appearance made the situation even more unpredictable. Chen Ji took a deep breath, yet a meaningful arc curved at the corner of his lips. Interesting. The more complex the situation, the more opportunities it conceals. Since Heaven wished to use him as a chess piece, he would become the one capable of devouring the chess player. This night was destined for no sleep. And the storm had only just begun. When Chen Ji traced the source of that gaze following the turtle shell's rune guidance, an unexpected name surfaced—the long-recluse First Generation Ancestor of the Tianqing Sect.
